Sevier White

Libertarian candidate for United States Senator, Oklahoma · Open seat

Sevier White is the Libertarian Party nominee for the U.S. Senate special election in Oklahoma on November 3, 2026, which fills the seat vacated by Markwayne Mullin. He filed for office in April 2026 and ran unopposed in the Libertarian primary. He previously ran for the U.S. House as a Libertarian in Oklahoma's 3rd Congressional District in 2000 and the 4th Congressional District in 2016.

Background

  • Libertarian candidate for U.S. House, Oklahoma's 3rd Congressional District (2000)
  • Libertarian candidate for U.S. House, Oklahoma's 4th Congressional District (2016)
  • Libertarian nominee for U.S. Senate, Oklahoma (2026); unopposed in the Libertarian primary
